IDENT.title: The MAS4AI framework for human-centered agile and smart manufacturing

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: Cites Russell & Norvig and Leitão (2009): 'An autonomous component that represents physical or logical objects in the system, capable to act in order to achieve its goals...'; holon treated as special type of agent.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: The MAS4AI project treats a holon as a special type of agent as well.

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: Leitão (2009) focuses on autonomy and interacting capabilities of agents

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: we employ a holonic multi-agent system, based on the RAMI4.0 reference architectural model and the use of AAS

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: A Resource Holon usually represents some production resource, for example, a production module, transportation vehicle or a smart worker.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: The knowledge graphs, based on the model shown in Figure 2, enable the holons to reason about the smart worker and to make informed decisions.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: The knowledge graphs, based on the model shown in Figure 2, enable the holons to reason about the smart worker

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: the agents use a well-known contract-net-protocol for the negotiation and allocation of the resources required to complete a production task

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: To increase scalability of the framework, we run diﬀerent holons in separate runtimes inside Docker containers.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: The SARL agent also has a set of behaviors, which consist of event handlers and event emitters. This enables to implement diﬀerent interaction protocols

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: The MAS used in the project is based on the Janus runtime for the general-purpose agent-oriented programming language SARL

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: conﬁgures itself with the worker’s proﬁle information from the worker’s AAS

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: AAS submodels hold worker role, qualifications, skills, capabilities, agenda; may hold performance monitoring results.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: can hold the results of performance monitoring/evaluation and various tests

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: The MAS4AI agents use the standard AAS API to get all the required information about the assets.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: The Resources submodel shows all the resources available to the holon

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: The holon tracks the worker’s location and updates the role in the AAS.

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: To interact with the other holons on behalf of the smart worker, the Human Digital Holon needs necessary information about a person.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: For the communication between such holons we use Kafka13 to build a robust agent messaging system. The I4.0 language is used as the agent communication language.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the agents use a well-known contract-net-protocol for the negotiation and allocation of the resources

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: The second scenario shows the interplay of distributed and hierarchical approaches for designing control systems, which are separated in time.

F_DT_COUPLING__dt_present_in_work.evidence_quote: Our approach is to combine the worker’s AAS as human’s passive DT with the Human Digital Holon, which actively represents a human in the system.

F_DT_COUPLING__agent_dt_coupling.evidence_quote: The human AAS described in Section 3.2 serves as the single source of truth about the worker and is a part of the Human Digital Holon.

F_DT_COUPLING__dt_generation_from_agent_.evidence_quote: the default Human Digital Holon is spawned with the corresponding worker’s AAS ID

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: A formal evaluation of the architecture and the MAS prototypes will be a part of the future work.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: When new equipment is introduced, it brings new capabilities to the system and the new production tasks can be accomplished.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: Case study: a human-robot shared assembly task

H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.evidence_quote: MASON (Lemaignan et al., 2006) provides a core model that conceptualizes core concepts of the PPR model

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: Two AAShosting platforms, BaSyx10 and Dimofac,11 have been used in the framework, and the MAS4AI agents could work with both of them

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: The task of the Product Holon is to ﬁnd and reserve the production resources that provide such capabilities.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Adds Human Digital Holon integrating workers via AAS; uses Behavior Trees orchestrated by a Task Holon for execution (hierarchical) rather than purely decentralized; AAS-based self-description for discovery.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: the Task Holon uses the hierarchical Behavior Trees structure to orchestrate the skills of the scheduled holons

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Standardization of AAS submodels and distributed planning claimed necessary/crucial.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: Standardization of the AAS submodels is crucial for interoperability and plugand-produce scenarios. Distributed planning and scheduling are necessary for modular reconﬁgurable architectures

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: After the holon is ready, it registers itself with the superordinate holon.
